response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced software craftsman with a strong background in distributed and high-performance systems. However, his recent professional experience does not align with the core C++ development requirement, and he lacks explicit mention of critical industrial cybersecurity standards (SDL, IEC 62443) and industrial automation domain expertise, which are central to this Senior Manager role.
strengths: Extensive experience (15+ years) in software development, exceeding seniority requirements.
Strong background in distributed and high-performance system architecture.
Proficiency in modern software craftsmanship and agile methodologies.
concerns: Limited and dated professional experience with C++ as the primary development language.
Absence of explicit experience with Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) or IEC 62443 industrial cybersecurity standards.
Lack of demonstrated background in industrial automation, IoT-specific protocols, or the manufacturing industry domain.
